title: HEED: Density-Weighted Residual Alignment for Hybrid Vision-Language Model Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2605.17093v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Distilling vision-language models into faster hybrid architectures, such as 3:1 Mamba-2/attention mixes, is now standard practice for making inference efficient. Aggregate benchmarks suggest that this works but they hide selective failures. When we distill Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct into a 3:1 Mamba-2/attention hybrid, student model stays within 2 points of the teacher across visual reasoning benchmarks like MMStar, MMBench, and MMMU-Pro, while dropping 13 points on optical-character-recognition and document tasks. The student can still understand the scene but loses the fine-grained text needed to answer. We localize much of the failure to a specific kind of position. In a high-resolution image, most patches are sky, wall, or smooth texture, while a small fraction carries text, edges, object boundaries, or other local details. translated_title: HEED：面向混合视觉语言模型蒸馏的密度加权残差对齐
translated_abstract: 将视觉语言模型蒸馏到更快速的混合架构（如3:1的Mamba-2/注意力混合结构）中，如今已成为实现高效推理的标准做法。整体基准测试显示该方法行之有效，但掩盖了选择性的失败。当我们将Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct蒸馏到3:1的Mamba-2/注意力混合架构中时，学生模型在MMStar、MMBench和MMMU-Pro等视觉推理基准上与教师模型的差距保持在2分以内，但在光学字符识别和文档任务上却下降了13分——学生模型仍能理解场景，却丢失了回答所需的细粒度文本。我们将这一失败的大部分原因定位于一类特定的位置：在高分辨率图像中，大多数图像块是天空、墙壁或平滑纹理，而一小部分图像块承载着文本、边缘、物体边界或其他局部细节。在token级别的诊断中，密度最高的前10%图像块的残差漂移比基线大3.6倍。
tldr: 该论文发现混合架构蒸馏的失败集中于承载文本与局部细节的高密度图像块（其残差漂移达3.6倍），并提出密度加权残差对齐方法HEED，有效修复了学生在OCR和文档任务上的细粒度信息丢失。
en_tdlr: HEED proposes density-weighted residual alignment for hybrid vision-language model distillation, revealing that distillation failures concentrate on high-density patches carrying text and fine-grained details (3.6x larger residual drift) and fixing the resulting performance drops on OCR and document tasks.
